caption: The video captures a close, eye-level outdoor view of a muddy clearing ringed by damp twigs and fallen branches, with a wet gray concrete block in the right foreground and a tree trunk, wooden bench, and dark sign in the background. A bare human arm reaches in from the left, its hand hovering low over a central pile of twigs with fingers curled in small adjustments. A small orange glow then appears among the twigs beneath the hand, and thin smoke begins to rise. The hand opens, lifts, and retracts upward and to the left, blurring as it moves out of view. With the hand gone, the ember continues to burn steadily in the same spot while smoke drifts upward. A brief motion-blur of an arm reappears at the top-left edge before vanishing again. The twig pile, block, and background remain largely stable, with no obvious camera shift. The small fire and its smoke continue to burn and rise through the remaining views.
